api.note: Key: OS credential store (Settings card) or the ISHTI_API_KEY variable, never this file. failover_local_model answers only while the cloud refuses, and only if Ollama is already running with it pulled; empty string disables failover. background_local: memory extraction runs on the local failover model when Ollama already has it (no API tokens). models: optional cheaper model per role, e.g. {"translator": "<mini model>"}.

learning.note: Reinforcement-like learning: feedback -> lesson -> memory/policy/dataset. Weights are NEVER changed at runtime; offline LoRA/QLoRA only (orchestrator/finetune.py) behind its eval gate. thresholds = confidence bands (spec 11); evidence = how many independent occasions before a lesson widens scope or becomes a candidate rule (spec 9/10); proactive=false means no volunteered suggestions until the owner asks.

barge_in.note: Tune on the real room: raise vad_threshold/min_ms if speaker echo interrupts; lower echo_overlap if your own words get ignored

voice.voices_note: Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0; synthetic voices, no real person cloned) is the live voice: CPU, no VRAM, ~4x faster than real time, speaks Urdu too. Piper voices are the classic fallback. Fish S2 was measured at 2.7x slower than real time and 15.2 of 16.3 GB VRAM next to Qwen - kept only as an optional download in Settings. The owner switches with 'use the deep male voice' or in Settings -> Models & voices.

gmail.note: Google Cloud Console -> APIs & Services -> Credentials -> Create OAuth client ID -> Application type **Desktop app**; enable the Gmail API. Desktop client secrets are not secret - they ship with the app - so they live here next to your config.

confirmation_thresholds.note: 0-2 observations = temporary; 3-5 weak; 6-10 probable; 11+ strong (promoted to semantic memory). Edit freely - nothing is hard-coded.

decay.note: Low-importance, long-unconfirmed memories are marked needs_confirmation (never deleted); importance >= floor is never decayed.

webtools.note: Chrome profile folder that webtools (cache, cookies, bookmarks) works on.

whatsapp.note: WAHA (WhatsApp HTTP API) in ISHTI own Docker container, published on 127.0.0.1 only. Image pinned by digest; the API key lives in Windows Credential Manager (ishti-waha), the container only gets its SHA-512 hash.
